case.title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement. Need: 20000 pc a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 7 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200004. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70620.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
sup:70620.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

You explained your pricing through labour and material costs, and you mentioned that multi-year volume agreements are where your prices can move. That is exactly why all three of our options run for a longer contract term, which gives your capacity a firm planning base.

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 85.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70620@2026Q3).

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.52; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.54; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

Since you may need to take this further internally, here is a short paragraph for your decision-maker. Could you please take Option A to that person?

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

We appreciate the years of reliable cooperation and look forward to a fair solution for both our firms.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. Regarding your request, please understand that as a matter of company policy, we do not share internal cost breakdowns. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month contract, which provides better planning stability and allows us to adjust our offer. Our Angebot stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. We can offer €4.90 per unit for Option A, incorporating the 45-day payment term and 24-month duration. As an alternative, we offer a price of €4.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Logistics: We have free capacity for your parts. Our Lieferzeit is 7 days. With overtime we can deliver in 7 days, at a premium.

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised offer and your continued interest in our products.

Our updated Angebot stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

We have reviewed your request internally and can offer a slight adjustment to €4.89 per unit for a 24-month contract with 45 days payment. This reflects our firm position given our current operational parameters. Alternatively, we can offer a price of €4.89 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership and remaining your trusted supplier.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

You told us that multi-year volume agreements are where your prices can move, and that is the point we have kept at the centre of our options.

Here are our options again, with a small step from us:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.61; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.66; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.63; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve: it pairs the shorter payment term with the long contract term you have said you value. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Option A gives Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd a firm multi-year agreement for the ball bearing 6306, a reliable planning base for its production, and a fair price for both family companies, with no further rounds needed. We would be grateful if you would take Option A to that person.

Thank you for your openness so far. We would like to settle this renewal in a way that works for both of us.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. 

We have reviewed your proposal for Option A, but we cannot accommodate a further price reduction for these terms. You mentioned volume agreements as a basis for price movement; please provide specific volume figures so we can review this. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. 

Please consider that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this offer is valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
